title: Rizia/Turn 10/STRIKE SCENE/ABSOLUTIST STRIKE SCENE/House Toras Strike/House Toras Strike Conversation

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: "“Family loyalty? You abandoned that..."
entries.dialogueText: “Family loyalty? You abandoned that the moment you took the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, then let me save you the tro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, then let me save you the trouble."
entries.menuText: "Well, then let me save you the trouble." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles.]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stepped over to the table and pen..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped over to the table and penned my name to the decree.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Let it be known that from this day..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let it be known that from this day forward, Hugo, you shall no longer hold your title, nor shall Ricardus or Hubertus.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Toras men stood in stunned sile..."
entries.dialogueText: The Toras men stood in stunned silence, their faces a mix of disbelief and shock.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You always did have a way with wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "You always did have a way with words. Tell it to the judge."
entries.menuText: "You always did have a way with words. Tell it to the judge." [Gesture at Titus to arrest him.]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The only stain on our bloodline is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only stain on our bloodline is you. Titus?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Congratulations. Your blood is wor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations. Your blood is worth no more than that of a commoner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Henceforth, I erase all your right..."
entries.dialogueText: "Henceforth, I erase all your rights, privileges, and noble standing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo turned to Titus. There was pan..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo turned to Titus. There was panic in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Titus?""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm sorry, old friend.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, old friend."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A flicker of hesitation crossed Tit..."
entries.dialogueText: A flicker of hesitation crossed Titus' face, but with a steadying breath, he pulled the trigger.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His jaw clenched tightly as Hugo's..."
entries.dialogueText: His jaw clenched tightly as Hugo's body crumpled lifelessly to the floor, blood pooling around him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not what I meant, Titus. Oh..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not what I meant, Titus. Oh well. Too late now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico and Hubertus stood in stunned..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico and Hubertus stood in stunned silence, their faces a mix of disbelief and shock.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus stood in stunned silence,..."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus stood in stunned silence, his face a mix of disbelief and shock.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and Hubertus stood in stunned..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and Hubertus stood in stunned silence, their faces a mix of disbelief and shock.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""FATHER!""
entries.dialogueText: "FATHER!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Something you'd like to add, Cousi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Something you'd like to add, Cousin?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You'll go to hell for this!""
entries.dialogueText: "You'll go to hell for this!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The sins of the family will not be..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sins of the family will not be overlooked."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Save your tears, Rico. Your father..."
entries.dialogueText: "Save your tears, Rico. Your father’s legacy is no longer of concern."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. Take him out.""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. Take him out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are lucky that I've spared you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are lucky that I've spared your life, cousin. Don't ever forget this day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded to Titus. The muzzle of hi..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to Titus. The muzzle of his gun flashed, and Rico was silenced forever.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arrest him immediately!""
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest him immediately!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God... I've wanted to do that for..."
entries.dialogueText: "God... I've wanted to do that for so long."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "'Goodbye, Ricardus.""
entries.dialogueText: 'Goodbye, Ricardus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough of this nonsense.""
entries.dialogueText: "Enough of this nonsense."
entries.menuText: "Enough of this nonsense." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles.]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to Hugo."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to Hugo.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Now’s your chance, Uncle. Show me..."
entries.dialogueText: “Now’s your chance, Uncle. Show me family loyalty above everything else and admit what you did."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Father. You don't need to explain..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father. You don't need to explain yourself."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Quiet, Rico.""
entries.dialogueText: "Quiet, Rico."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo took a commanding step toward..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo took a commanding step toward me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stared him down, not uttering a w..."
entries.dialogueText: I stared him down, not uttering a word.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you've now recognized the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you've now recognized the seriousness of your situation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If you're expecting some sort of a..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're expecting some sort of admission, you won't get anything out of me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“What say you, House Toras? Is ther..."
entries.dialogueText: “What say you, House Toras? Is there anything you'd like to confess before the Lord?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tarnished it may be, but *my* bloo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tarnished it may be, but *my* bloodline will be just fine. Though, I can't say the same for *yours*."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked to Titus, a single, silent..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked to Titus, a single, silent command passing between us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without hesitation, he raised his g..."
entries.dialogueText: Without hesitation, he raised his gun and fired. A single shot echoed through the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico’s body crumpled lifelessly to..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico’s body crumpled lifelessly to the floor, blood pooling around him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo screamed, his face pale with h..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo screamed, his face pale with horror as he watched his son fall. Hubertus sat frozen, his mouth agape in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You… How could you? YOU KILLED MY..."
entries.dialogueText: "You… How could you? YOU KILLED MY SON!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo fell to the floor and took Ric..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo fell to the floor and took Rico in his arms, rocking him back and forth. His face was ashen and hollow, eyes locked on his son’s lifeless form.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, take him into custody -- im..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, take him into custody -- immediately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus motioned to several nearby me..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus motioned to several nearby men in uniform, who picked Hugo off the ground, tied his hands behind his back and escorted him to the far wall.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus, see to it that he joins his..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus, see to it that he joins his son in the afterlife."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could register what had ha..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could register what had happened, Hugo hit the floor, dead -- the shot from Titus’s gun still ringing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus stared at the blood on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus stared at the blood on the floor, his mouth trembling in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Well?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Well?”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“The truth, Hubertus. I’ll have it..."
entries.dialogueText: “The truth, Hubertus. I’ll have it now, one way or another.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you finally ready to admit wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you finally ready to admit what you've done?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus looked petrified."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus looked petrified.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have time for this.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have time for this."
entries.menuText: "I don't have time for this." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles.]

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""There’s nothing to judge! You hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "There’s nothing to judge! You hear me? My conscience is clear! Can you say the same?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enjoy that clean conscience in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enjoy that clean conscience in the dark cell waiting for you. Perhaps it’ll keep you company."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If only self-righteousness were a..."
entries.dialogueText: "If only self-righteousness were a defense. Shame it’s not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your conscience may be clear, but..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your conscience may be clear, but your hands are stained. And I will see that justice is done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing, letting silence be..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing, letting silence be my answer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo thrashed against the guards’ g..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo thrashed against the guards’ grip, his voice rising in protest, as they tied his hands behind his back and hauled him to the far side of the room.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You fucking monster.""
entries.dialogueText: "You fucking monster."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Ricardus! Do not test His Majesty'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ricardus! Do not test His Majesty's patience further!"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""What is there to lose? Can't you s..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is there to lose? Can't you see he's set on destroying us all?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico redirected his anger toward me..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico redirected his anger toward me.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You know what you are? You’re just..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know what you are? You’re just a scared little man hiding behind all this -- what, power? Fear?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You're got nothing but weakness in..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're got nothing but weakness in you! You’re no king of mine!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could react, Rico spat in..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could react, Rico spat in my face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's the last mistake you'll eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the last mistake you'll ever make. Titus. Shoot him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A bit too eager to make your point..."
entries.dialogueText: "A bit too eager to make your point, don’t you think?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arrest him at once!""
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest him at once!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I displayed no outward reaction."
entries.dialogueText: I displayed no outward reaction.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty, this man has defied..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, this man has defied the King of Rizia to his face -- an act demanding the gravest consequence. How do you wish me to proceed?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus grabbed Rico by his hair and..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus grabbed Rico by his hair and yanked him back, eliciting a cry of pain from my insubordinate cousin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stand down, Titus. He is no threat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stand down, Titus. He is no threat anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Put him behind bars to get his per..."
entries.dialogueText: "Put him behind bars to get his perspective sorted.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's not necessary, Titus. Small..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not necessary, Titus. Small creatures may snap at a lion’s heel, but the lion remains unmoved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He has committed treason. For that..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has committed treason. For that, he must pay with his life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“From henceforth, the Toras family..."
entries.dialogueText: “From henceforth, the Toras family shall have no claim to Valenqiris. There is only the Crown.”

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Go on, throw me behind bars! It wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go on, throw me behind bars! It won’t change the truth!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He barely had time to curse me befo..."
entries.dialogueText: He barely had time to curse me before two guards seized him and dragged him back to the area where Hugo was being held.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I directed my attention toward Hube..."
entries.dialogueText: I directed my attention toward Hubertus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hubertus stared at the blood on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Hubertus stared at the blood on the floor, his mouth quivering in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned my attention toward Hubert..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned my attention toward Hubertus, who looked petrified.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do go on. I’m fascinated to hear w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do go on. I’m fascinated to hear what else you have to say... while you still have the chance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Don't you know that monsters have..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't you know that monsters have a way of making nightmares real? Guards, take him away."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps you'd like to join your fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you'd like to join your father?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico looked away, swallowing hard."
entries.dialogueText: Rico looked away, swallowing hard.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""My apologies. I was out of line.""
entries.dialogueText: "My apologies. I was out of line."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“A monster? Is that the best you've..."
entries.dialogueText: “A monster? Is that the best you've got, Rico? If that’s all you see, then perhaps you’re not paying attention.”
entries.menuText: “A monster? Is that the best you've got, Rico? If that’s all you see, then perhaps you’re not paying attention.” [Execute Rico]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What say you, Hubertus? Anything y..."
entries.dialogueText: "What say you, Hubertus? Anything you'd like to add?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now's your chance to apologize too..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now's your chance to apologize too, Hubertus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only one of you apologized. Intere..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only one of you apologized. Interesting..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: "“Your father would have been ashame..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your father would have been ashamed to see what you've become -- a ruler who'd cast his own family aside in pursuit of power."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The only thing I have to 'confess'..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only thing I have to 'confess' is that I swore my fealty to a king who never returned it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I gave you my trust, Romus. And fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I gave you my trust, Romus. And for family to betray family... that wound never heals."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""He never deserved your loyalty.""
entries.dialogueText: "He never deserved your loyalty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's enough, Rico.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's enough, Rico."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I don't know what your game is, Ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what your game is, Romus, but if you want some sort of admission, you'll get nothing out of me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whether you speak or not, the outc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether you speak or not, the outcome remains the same."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your stubbornness is almost admira..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your stubbornness is almost admirable. Almost."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I almost pity you, Uncle -- holdin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I almost pity you, Uncle -- holding on to pride as everything else crumbles around you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I swore undying loyalty to you, as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swore undying loyalty to you, as family should, but you gave me nothing in return."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""'Stubbornness?' No. It's convictio..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Stubbornness?' No. It's conviction. Something you traded away the moment you put that crown on your head."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You speak of pride as if it’s a fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You speak of pride as if it’s a failing, but after today, it seems it might be all I have left."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And for family to betray family......"
entries.dialogueText: "And for family to betray family... that wound never heals."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Father. You don't need to explain..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father. You don't need to explain yourself."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Quiet, Rico.""
entries.dialogueText: "Quiet, Rico."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Drop the act, Hugo. I know it was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Drop the act, Hugo. I know it was you who killed Father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you think would have disap..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think would have disappointed him more? What I've become, or the cowardice you've embraced?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you think your little moral lec..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you think your little moral lecture matters at this point, you’re gravely mistaken."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Cowardice?!""
entries.dialogueText: "Cowardice?!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What do you take me for, my nephew?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you take me for, my nephew?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Damn it, Romus. Do you even hear y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Damn it, Romus. Do you even hear yourself?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You’ll rot in hell for this!""
entries.dialogueText: "You’ll rot in hell for this!"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You’ll burn for what you've done!""
entries.dialogueText: "You’ll burn for what you've done!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before he could get a word out, two..."
entries.dialogueText: Before he could get a word out, two guards seized him and hauled him to the far side of the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to Hubertus."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to Hubertus.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Please, Your Majesty. I'm sure we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. I'm sure we can amicably resolve any grievances you have with us."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""There's still time to make this ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's still time to make this right."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I suggest you stop now, Your Grace..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suggest you stop now, Your Grace--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo held up a hand, silencing her,..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo held up a hand, silencing her, before turning his gaze back to me.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Dear God...""
entries.dialogueText: "Dear God..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo and..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo and Rico, as if struggling to process what had happened.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Dear God...""
entries.dialogueText: "Dear God..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo and..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo and Rico, as if struggling to process what had happened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo, as..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's gaze lingered on Hugo, as if struggling to process what had happened.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you lack the stomach for hard d..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you lack the stomach for hard decisions, perhaps it’s best you remain silent."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Agreed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, leverage is everything.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, leverage is everything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sometimes things fall into place w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes things fall into place when you have the proper leverage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, but let’s not get ahead of ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A reminder that the simplest appro..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reminder that the simplest approach can often be the most effective."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps you underestimated my reso..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you underestimated my resolve. A mistake, I trust, you won't make again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may not see it now, but this w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not see it now, but this will secure the future of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her frustration was evident, but sh..."
entries.dialogueText: Her frustration was evident, but she said nothing further.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I never imagined you would take it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never imagined you would take it this far, Romus."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well, that went more smoothly than..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that went more smoothly than anticipated."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Naturally.""
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty... I never imagined y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... I never imagined you would take it this far."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita stepped near me, leaning in..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita stepped near me, leaning in to whisper.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your resolve is clearer than ever.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your resolve is clearer than ever."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I truly hope you're right, for all..."
entries.dialogueText: "I truly hope you're right, for all our sakes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I don't know what your game is, Ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what your game is, Romus, but I refuse to play along."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whether you play or not, the outco..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether you play or not, the outcome remains the same."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I don't know what your game is, Ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what your game is, Romus, but I refuse to be a part of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now's your chance, Uncle. Prove to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now's your chance, Uncle. Prove to me that family loyalty comes before all else."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Father never gave a damn about me,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father never gave a damn about me, and neither did you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Every action I've taken has been f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every action I've taken has been for Rizia -- and Rizia alone."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Place him under arrest.""
entries.dialogueText: "Place him under arrest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Shoot him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Shoot him."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the first time, I saw terror in..."
entries.dialogueText: For the first time, I saw terror in my guardsman's eyes, betraying his usual composed demeanor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Disgust was written all over his fa..."
entries.dialogueText: Disgust was written all over his face. I looked at Rico.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. Shoot him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. Shoot him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's over, Hugo. Under the authori..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's over, Hugo. Under the authority vested in me as king, I place you under arrest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Here, I'll save you the trouble.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here, I'll save you the trouble."
entries.menuText: "Here, I'll save you the trouble." [Sign the decree to revoke House Toras' titles and seize Valenqiris]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rico sprang from his seat, but arme..."
entries.dialogueText: Rico sprang from his seat, but armed men quickly descended upon him, pinning him to the ground.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus. Take him out as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus. Take him out as well."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""May the Divine curse your soul, Ro..."
entries.dialogueText: "May the Divine curse your soul, Romus."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm sorry, old friend.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, old friend."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A flicker of hesitation crossed Tit..."
entries.dialogueText: A flicker of hesitation crossed Titus' face, but with a steadying breath, he pulled the trigger.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""May he find redemption in the afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "May he find redemption in the afterlife."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""May he find redemption in the afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "May he find redemption in the afterlife."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without a moment's hesitation, his..."
entries.dialogueText: Without a moment's hesitation, his guardsmen grabbed Hugo and dragged him toward the back wall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio grabbed Hugo and dragged him..."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio grabbed Hugo and dragged him toward the back wall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded to Titus, who gave the sig..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to Titus, who gave the signal.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""You know what to do. Move!""
entries.dialogueText: "You know what to do. Move!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded to Titus, who gave the sig..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded to Titus, who gave the signal to Sevrio.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What?! How dare you even--""
entries.dialogueText: "What?! How dare you even--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He recoiled in anger. When he spoke..."
entries.dialogueText: He recoiled in anger. When he spoke again, it was without passion.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""All these years, I have done nothi..."
entries.dialogueText: "All these years, I have done nothing but stand by you and your family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""When the rest of our family called..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the rest of our family called your mother a gold-digging harlot -- not without merit, mind you -- who came to her defense?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""All those years you were unfaithfu..."
entries.dialogueText: "All those years you were unfaithful to your wife -- who do you think helped keep that a secret?!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I didn't say a word when you and y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't say a word when you and your butler revealed your shameful *proclivities* to the world."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I never said a word about your bar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never said a word about your barely disguised *proclivities*, despite them being an affront to God and nature."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And even when you sent my son to h..."
entries.dialogueText: "And even when you sent my son to his doom--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His voice caught in his throat."
entries.dialogueText: His voice caught in his throat.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Did I lash out? No! I gracefully s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did I lash out? No! I gracefully stepped down to continue serving House Toras from afar."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even when you humiliated my only s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even when you humiliated my only son--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His voice caught in his throat."
entries.dialogueText: His voice caught in his throat.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even then, I chose to serve you ra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even then, I chose to serve you rather than lash out in defense of his honor."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even when your daughter made a moc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even when your daughter made a mockery of my son on their wedding day--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at Rico, who was practica..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at Rico, who was practically seething.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes, there were times when House T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, there were times when House Toras entreated me to take your place as the rightful king, and times when I dared to dream of how I would rule in your stead."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I never, ever would have gone..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I never, ever would have gone so far as to contemplate rising against you, my nephew."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Until now. You have simply gone to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Until now. You have simply gone too far."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes, there were times when I dared..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, there were times when I dared to dream of how I would rule in your stead."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With quivering hands, Hubertus made..."
entries.dialogueText: With quivering hands, Hubertus made his way to the table and signed the decree revoking House Toras' titles and transferring its lands to the Crown's ownership.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And I am willing to go even furthe..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am willing to go even further. Sign the papers or face the consequences."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you admit it. House Toras is gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you admit it. House Toras is guilty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why can't you just admit it? You m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why can't you just admit it? You murdered King Valero!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps my harshness towards you h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps my harshness towards you has been misguided. But I cannot turn back now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo's face was full of indescribab..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo's face was full of indescribable sadness.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Do what you must. But no matter ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do what you must. But no matter how much you tarnish our bloodline, I will not betray the honor of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""NO!""
entries.dialogueText: "NO!"
